title: VNC: Minor fixes in vnc.c
description:
Issues addressed:
- Incorrect descriptions order.
- Incorrectly signed QEMU Audio pseudo-encoding. Probably it has been confused with `TLS encryption with Plain authentication` constant which, indeed, has the same absolute value.
- Missing macros descriptions.

notes.body:

- VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_POINTER_CHANGE, after VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_FTP_PROTO_VER
- VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_EXT_KEY_EVENT, after VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_POINTER_CHANGE

and the value_string VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_EXTENDED_DESK_SIZE should be swapped with VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_DESKTOP_NAME

commits_data.title: VNC: Add description to VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_AUDIO
commits_data.message:
VNC: Add description to VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_AUDIO

VNC_ENCODING_TYPE_AUDIO stands for QEMU Audio Pseudo-encoding

See: https://github.com/rfbproto/rfbproto/blob/master/rfbproto.rst#qemu-audio-pseudo-encoding

commits_data.title: VNC: Fix QEMU Audio pseudo-encoding value
commits_data.message:
VNC: Fix QEMU Audio pseudo-encoding value

See: https://github.com/qemu/qemu/blob/5136598e2667f35ef3dc1d757616a266bd5eb3a2/ui/vnc.h#L416
